label: Conventional hydrological signatures
purpose: Interpretable practical analogue baseline. Because it includes rainfall, it is not the isolated test of temporal pretraining.

label: Raw 512-observation discharge history
input_scope: Standardized hourly discharge at relative hours -511 through 0
purpose: Same-input nearest-neighbour control for the frozen TTM representation.

label: Frozen TTM-R2 discharge representation
input_scope: The identical standardized 512-observation discharge history used by R1
purpose: Same-input test of the frozen TTM representation's incremental value beyond raw hydrograph similarity; it does not causally isolate pretraining.

label: Prior-year AlphaEarth catchment context
input_scope: Fixed event representation plus prior-year catchment embedding on the common 2018+ subset
purpose: Bounded incremental context test against the same event representation without learned catchment context and with catchment area as a simple held-data control. Event rows do not create independent catchment evidence.

label: Fused conventional and TTM event representations
condition: Run only if R0 and R2 show different and individually useful retrieval behavior on the common temporal sample.
purpose: Tests complementarity without making fusion a dissertation requirement.
